note: Measured on an idle developer machine against a v0.9.0 worktree (--plugin-root). Absolute times depend on the machine and its CPU state: the same idle machine gave p95 values about 20% apart in two sessions, and v0.9.0 and 0.9.1 matched within 1% when measured back to back. A latency budget (AR-45) therefore measures v0.9.0 and the checkout in the same run and compares those; this file records the reference shape and order of magnitude.
